title: Cemetery-vertex condensation and the JWST hydrogen cocoon
html: We classify the isolated vertex using the underlying quantum structure. The Cemetery tilting modules lock the primordial plasma onto a rigid spectrahedral vertex. This forces the plasma to condense into minimum-action Borromean B_3 assemblies. This condensation produces the massive, dust-free cocoon of atomic hydrogen and \text{H}_2 gas observed by JWST.
